name: anomalyco/hex
title: Hex 3.5 adds free, local meeting recording with transcripts agents can search via `hex meetings search`
summary: The Rust rewrite of the Hex dictation app now records calls locally, offers a copy-agent-prompt action and a CLI that scopes transcript search to one meeting, and `hex transcribe` handles audio and video files without the app open. A local alternative to cloud meeting bots for people who want agents to read their calls.
